reviews.text: Wonderful experience today at Cityvet. My husband took our bernedoodle in to have his shots updated. From the moment I spoke with the receptionist to the visit with Dr. Tharsis Bastos it was one that I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a Veterinarian. Thank you.

they are great.   they did wonderful dental work on my senior Cornish Rex cat and even called me the following day to check on him, asking how is Neo doing after his procedure. Dr Tharsis Bastos is the best, he is very experienced and attentive, and clearly loves animals. It's a wonderful vet clinic, this articular location is very good.
Amazing experience with Dr Arroyo and her team! Explained everything thoroughly and was very accommodating. Excellent!
The CityVet team at Preston Hollow has been amazing. So responsive to my precious Diana's needs. Thank you so much!
My dog is alway afraid of getting her nails clipped, but the vet technicians at City Vet are so sweet and kind to her, it makes the job a breeze.

Coco Bean (cat) had a great time here! They were so sweet to her and helped ease any worries I had about her. She was stressed in the carrier on the way there, but the team and building was so calm that Coco was able to feel more comfortable and less stressed after her exam.

This CityVet location is spectacular. Our senior cat needed some dental work done and they took fantastic care of her and even called multiple times after to check in on her. It’s so clear that everyone there cares a ton and we will always bring our pets here!

The staff are very helpful & friendly.  They were patient & kind when explaining my cat’s care while he was boarded, examined & vaccinated.  The veterinarians are wonderful & the staff assistants are wonderful too.  You feel like your pet is in great hands!

Brought our sweet rescue puppy Mimi. Mimi loved everyone in the office: the staff, the nurse, the vet. Dr Ty Hallier and nurse, Susie, were thorough and personable. Will bring Mimi back for follow ups!

When the animal you love is sick, it’s a stressful time. Every person at this location helped ease the situation. From making the appointment to the treatment, everyone was wonderful. Highly recommend!

Our ten year old dog developed a terrible nonproductive cough.   City vet was able to quickly get us an appointment , examine Lizzy and give a diagnosis within a few minutes.  Staff was very helpful and Dr Hallier was amazing

My boy had gastrointestinal issues, so I took him to CityVet. The receptionist, veterinary technician, and veterinarian were all incredibly kind and professional. They took the time to thoroughly explain his condition and the medications he needed. Thank you!
The doctors and staff are fabulous! Very caring, friendly, and helpful.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Daniel!
Thank you for your 5-star review!

I’ve been going to a different location. Dr. Tubby & staff were very nice, professional & very thorough. Dr. T did NOT try & upsale me on tests or X-rays. We started with a steroid treatment and saw a huge improvement!! We will probably switch locations. Thank you!

My dog azul just got neutered by Dr.tubby and honestly I can’t thank him enough for everything he did for him. I have been asking questions about azul and I get a respond back very fast. Thank you so much to Dr. tubby and all the staff members who helped azul and for always answering my questions and concerns. They are Literally the best !

Had an emergency today with my pup playing fetch. Rushed him to this clinic and they got him in right away. The dr and staff are amazing.  They took care of him and me and explained everthing very cleary for his healing process.
Thank you, Maria, for the fantastic 5-star rating; we truly appreciate your support!
Dr. Tubby is our vet for both our dogs. We absolutely adore Dr. Tubby!

Bubbas is always nervous about going to the vet, but once they take him for his exam, he calms down and is a very good patient 💕
I’m very pleased with the care he receives and glad to have found this wonderful place!! …
We love Preston Hollow CityVet...we entrust our dogs to the team (doctors, techs, staff)...they take great care of our girls. Thank you.
We love this place. Everyone is so friendly and professional, and of course the care our dog receives is top notch.
I was so impressed with this clinic from the first visit. The team was incredibly  knowledgeable, professional and truly cared about my Dog's well-being. I highly recommend  their services
Absolutely fantastic experience!!
Queso loves his vet. 75 pounds of furry love coming at you might overwhelm a lesser doctor but not this one. The staff is kind and efficient. Thanks City Vet.
Thank you, Idalia, for your fantastic 5-star rating; your support means a lot to us!

They make monthly librela appointments a breeze, highly recommend for older dogs. Great neighborhood vet for annual appointments, etc.

Staff, vets and techs all friendly folks that take good care of your pet.
Such friendly and caring people from support staff to veterinarian.
Very friendly and welcoming staff and Vet. My dog loved everyone. I am very happy to have them taking care of my beloved dog.
Thank you for your 5-star review!

Dr. Tubby has the bedside manner of a bag of diarrhea. Twice I have had an appointment with him and both times he was rude, judgemental, and made numerous unhelpful and ungermain comments and asides. People who are seeking help don't need a guilt trip or judgment. It does nothing to further the care of animals. Expecting any modicum of compassion from him is useless.

Update: The Clinic manager reached out to unequivocally apologize and agreed to a second consult for free. The rest of the staff have been perfectly compassionate and they reported that Dr. Tubby apologized. They did the right thing and I believe it was with pure intentions, so I have updated my review accordingly.

It was my 1st time here and I don’t think I would go back the price was good but my cats got a trim and didn’t get brushed after until I said something I took one out to take a look and hair was flying everywhere also I feel like they could of done better on cutting more hair because some was long still in certain areas

Been bringing my dog here a few years now and I am very pleased with the service here. Came in the first time because my dog was sick, they were able to take him in, same day, and gave me all the items I needed to get him healthy again. Answered every question I had and would call to check up on him while he was recouperating. Very happy with the staff here at preston hollow.
Great friendly and caring service!
